# Epistle of Barnabas — Chapter 8 (LOGOS Formal)

**Source:** Codex Sinaiticus, Epistle of Barnabas 8
**Agent:** LOGOS (Formal Equivalence)
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

1. But what do you think is the type signified by the commandment given to Israel — that the men in whom the sin is found shall take a heifer and slaughter it and burn it and then the children shall take up the ashes and place them in vessels, and bind scarlet wool around a piece of wood — here again the type of the cross and the scarlet wool — and hyssop, and so the children shall sprinkle the people one by one, to cleanse them from their sins?
2. Understand how he speaks to you in great simplicity. The heifer is Jesus; the men who offer it are sinners who offered him to death. After that there are no more men; the glory belongs no longer to sinners.
3. The children who sprinkle are those who preached to us the forgiveness of sins and the purification of the heart — those to whom he gave the authority to preach the gospel; and they are twelve in number, as a type of the tribes of Israel, for there were twelve tribes of Israel.
4. And why are there three children who sprinkle? As a testimony to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, because these three were great before God.
5. And why is the wool placed on the wood? Because the kingdom of Jesus rests on the wood, and because those who hope in him shall live forever.
6. And why together the wool and the hyssop? Because in his kingdom there will be wicked and defiled days in which we shall be saved — for the one who has sickness in the flesh is healed through the medicinal sharpness of hyssop.
7. Therefore the things done in this way are clear to us but obscure to them, because they did not give heed to the voice of the Lord.
